name: io.github.jakegu1/crypto-agent-risk
description: Crypto token risk intelligence MCP: assess a token's risk (liquidity depth, honeypot check, pool freshness) and return an actionable low/medium/high verdict with a recommendation for AI agents.

tools.name: assess_token_risk
tools.description: Aggregate multi-chain liquidity/contract safety/freshness into an actionable risk verdict (low/medium/high) plus a recommendation for the agent. Address should be an ERC-20 or Solana contract address.

tools.name: get_token_liquidity
tools.description: Return a token's main pair liquidity snapshot: price, 24h volume, cross-chain count.

tools.name: find_new_hot_pools
tools.description: Scan a chain (default solana) for newest or hottest new pools; returns price/liquidity/volume overview for new-token discovery and risk assessment.
